description.shortText: Through bright LEDs, machine vision monitoring, and cameras, this crosswalk disappears late at night and reappears as needed, allowing the street to adapt to the traffic flow and create safer areas for pedestrians while incentivizing fun and gamification of daily life.

attachments.name: Smart crosswalk reacts to cars and pedestrians in real time
attachments.description: Starling Crossing is a responsive road surface created by London-based urban tech firm Umbrellium that reacts in real time to different traffic and pedestrian conditions.

attachments.name: Smarter Sidewalks
attachments.description: Brett Snyder University of California Davis, Department of Design ABSTRACT How we navigate the streets has changed radically over the past decade, thanks largely to new technologies. attachments.name: Detroit: Become Human
attachments.description: Directed by David Cage.  With Valorie Curry, Bryan Dechart, Jesse Williams, Audrey Boustani. The game allows you to take control of three androids in their quest to discover who they really are.

attachments.name: Interactive walkway and gaming method employing same
attachments.description: An interactive walkway includes a plurality of walkway segments, each of the walkway segments being associated with a signal generator, a physical location, and an identifying indicium, and at least one receiver in communication with the signal generators, the at least one receiver being adapted to receive a transmission and activate at least one of the signal generators upon receipt of the transmission. Gaming methods that make use of the interactive walkway are also disclosed.
